title: chat.completions: normalize response framing + expanded params mapping for OpenAI parity
author: Anika Bose
release_notes: Adds improved /v1/chat.completions parity: normalized streaming frames and SSE markers, fuller params mapping (max_tokens/top_p/temperature), consistent role normalization, stop sequence handling compatible with OpenAI semantics, optional logprobs passthrough for non-streamed responses, and better function-calling signal propagation. No breaking changes; opt-in compatibility mode behind flag.
body:
Context: Customers using the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat.completions endpoint reported differences in streaming frame boundaries, stop token semantics, and function-calling signal fields compared to OpenAI behavior. This causes client-side parsers built against OpenAI samples to mis-handle partial frames and finish_reason mapping. Motivation: reduce customer friction for migration and for reference integrations (SDKs/examples) by matching OpenAI semantics where safe. Design summary: 1) Streaming framing: introduce deterministic SSE 'data:' framing for delta and done events and ensure each delta frame includes an explicit 'delta.role' when the role changes (mirrors OpenAI behavior). 2) Response normalization: unify finish_reason values (stop, length, function_call, null) and ensure they are present both in streaming final event and aggregated response. 3) Params mapping: expand parameter pass-through for max_tokens, top_p, temperature, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty and map Redwood internal param names to OpenAI names in compat mode. 4) Roles: normalize incoming message roles (assistant/system/user) and canonicalize 'system'->'system', accept 'assistant' and 'bot' aliases. 5) Stop/logprobs: support array/string stop tokens exactly like OpenAI, ensure early termination sets finish_reason=stop and attach logprobs payload when requested for non-stream responses. 6) Function calling: forward function_call hint objects in the same shape OpenAI sends, and on generated function calls attach name/arguments in both streaming deltas and final aggregated output. Checklist: - [x] Streaming frame format implemented and unit-tested - [x] finish_reason canonicalization - [x] params mapping into runtime config - [x] role alias handling and validation - [x] stop token handling covered by integration test - [x] logprobs passthrough for non-stream - [x] function_call propagation during streaming - [x] e2e compatibility test with SDK fixtures (python/ts) Changes (high-level): - runtime/stream/framer.py: new SSE framing util and tests - api/openai/compat_layer.py: mapping layer for request/response transformations - runtime/exec/params_mapper.py: expanded mapping table and validation - sdk_fixtures/compat/ : added sample conversations and parser tests - tests/integration/test_openai_compat.py: added multiple scenarios covering streaming and non-streamed behavior - docs/openai-compat.md: documentation and migration notes Commits: - Implement SSE framing util and wire into stream dispatcher (Anika Bose) - Add response normalizer for finish_reason and role mapping (Diego Morales) - Map extra params and add validation layer; update tests and fixtures (Anika Bose) Testing notes: Initial CI run surfaced a flaky test in streaming framing where SSE chunk boundaries were split by network simulation; fixed by increasing buffer coalescing window and adding deterministic boundary tests. Integration tests validated parity against a small OpenAI-conformant harness (fixtures in sdk_fixtures). Rollout plan: feature gated behind API compatibility flag (openai_compat: true). Default behavior unchanged. Soft rollout to internal customers for 48 hours, then flip compat mode default for new accounts after telemetry review. Backout plan: revert feature flag and fast-forward a hotfix branch if we observe parsing regressions in the field. Compatibility/Interop notes: This change is additive; existing Redwood clients not using the compatibility flag see no change. Some third-party clients expecting Redwood's old framing need to opt-in to avoid parsing differences. Security/Privacy: no changes to PII handling or logging.

References: Linear ENG-3421 (streaming stability), ENG-3490 (openai compat wave 2). Related PRs: RED-PR-50321 (previous stream framing fixes).
commits: 3 commits: 1) add sse framer and integration tests; 2) finish reason normalizer + role aliasing; 3) params mapper + function_call passthrough and docs
review_comments: Diego Morales: Nit: can we add an invariant test that verifies finish_reason is present in both streaming final event and aggregated response? -> Added test in tests/integration/test_openai_compat.py line 78

Sara Kim: Question: does logprobs propagation significantly increase payload size for embeddings/large responses? Anika: only enabled when logprobs=true and limited to top_k=5 by default in compat mode to bound size
Evan Liu: Approve after tests green and small lint cleanup. -> Addressed lint errors and re-ran CI
notes_for_changelog: OpenAI compatibility: normalized streaming framing and finish_reason values; extended params mapping; function_call streaming propagation; improved stop token handling and optional logprobs for non-streamed responses. This improves interop for clients migrating from OpenAI to Redwood.
